lines.say: He punched the ball | into the net | with his hand, | in front of | one-hundred-fourteen-thousand-five-hundred-eighty | people.
lines.show: He punched the ball into the net with his hand, in front of 114,580 people.

lines.say: You see, it was | the fifty-first minute | of a World Cup | quarter-final, | Argentina against England.
lines.show: You see, it was the 51st minute of a World Cup quarter-final, Argentina against England.

lines.say: Then an England midfielder | hooked the ball back | toward his own goal.
So the keeper | rushed out | to meet it.
But Maradona leapt | with his left arm up, | and his fist | got there first.
The ball floated | over the keeper's head | and dropped | into the goal.
Suddenly, | England's players | protested the handball.
But the referee | hadn't seen the hand, | so the goal stood.
After the game, | Maradona said | it was scored | a little | with the head | of Maradona, | and a little | with the hand | of God.
lines.show: After the game, Maradona said it was scored "a little with the head of Maradona, and a little with the hand of God."

lines.say: Four minutes later, | he ran from | his own half, | past four England players | and the keeper, | and scored the | Goal of the Century.
